{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = case['required_symbols']
    
    # Build lookup and parent->children map
    node_map = {}
    children = {}  # parent_id -> list of child ids
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        node_map[nid] = n
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(nid)
    
    # Validate: root exists
    root_candidates = [nid for nid, n in node_map.items() if n['parent'] is None]
    if len(root_candidates) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Tree must have exactly one root')
    root_id = root_candidates[0]
    
    # Validate: all required symbols initially present
    symbol_counts = {}
    for n in node_map.values():
        s = n['symbol']
        symbol_counts[s] = symbol_counts.get(s, 0) + 1
    for rsym in required_symbols:
        if symbol_counts.get(rsym, 0) == 0:
            raise ValueError(f'Required symbol {rsym!r} not present in tree')
    
    # Initial retained set (all nodes)
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    
    # Sort nodes by descending depth, then by id lexicographically
    sorted_nodes = sorted(node_map.values(), key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    
    removed_node_ids = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['parent'] is None:  # root
            continue
        # Check for retained children
        has_retained_child = any(cid in retained for cid in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Check if removing this node would lose a required symbol
        symb = node['symbol']
        if symb in required_symbols:
            # Count how many retained nodes have this symbol (including this one)
            cnt = sum(1 for n in node_map.values() if n['symbol'] == symb and n['id'] in retained)
            if cnt == 1:  # this node is the only one
                continue
        # Remove node
        retained.remove(nid)
        removed_node_ids.append(nid)
    
    retained_node_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {'removed_node_ids': removed_node_ids, 'retained_node_ids': retained_node_ids}
"
}
